# arin_rpki_provisioning (Data Source)

Read an RFC 6492 delegated provisioning inventory using an existing BPKI identity. Authenticates the parent response and checks protocol structure and resource syntax. Does not issue/revoke certificates, validate their RPKI trust paths, enroll accounts, or use ARIN_API_KEY. Updates persistent local exchange journals; uncertain exchanges block automatic retry. Native ARIN delegated sandbox verification remains unavailable.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Requires an existing delegated provisioning identity and enrollment.
# Keep the key file and persistent journal directory private.
data "arin_rpki_provisioning" "example" {
  endpoint                = "https://parent.example.net/provisioning/child"
  child_handle            = "child"
  parent_handle           = "parent"
  journal_directory       = pathexpand("~/.local/state/arin-rpki")
  signing_key_file        = pathexpand("~/.config/arin-rpki/signing-key.pem")
  signing_certificate_pem = file("signing-ee.pem")
  signing_ca_pem          = file("local-ca.pem")
  signing_crls_pem        = file("local-crls.pem")
  peer_ca_pem             = file("parent-ca.pem")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `child_handle` (String) Assigned child handle from the parent response.
- `endpoint` (String) Provisioning service URL from a trusted parent response. Requires HTTPS except HTTP on loopback for tests.
- `journal_directory` (String) Absolute path to an existing private directory for durable signing-time and pending-request journals. Must persist between runs. Failed exchanges can require recovery before further reads.
- `parent_handle` (String) Parent handle from the trusted parent response.
- `peer_ca_pem` (String) Explicit parent BPKI trust anchor established out of band, in PEM format.
- `signing_ca_pem` (String) Explicit local BPKI trust anchor in PEM format.
- `signing_certificate_pem` (String) Existing BPKI signing EE certificate in PEM format.
- `signing_crls_pem` (String) Concatenated current PEM CRLs for the local BPKI signing chain.
- `signing_key_file` (String) Local private RSA key file, PKCS#8 or PKCS#1 PEM, with no group or other permissions. Symlinks are rejected. Only the path is retained in Terraform state; key bytes are never returned.

### Optional

- `peer_intermediates_pem` (String) Concatenated parent BPKI intermediate certificates, if needed.
- `signing_intermediates_pem` (String) Concatenated local BPKI intermediate CA certificates, if needed.

### Read-Only

- `classes` (Attributes List) Resource classes sorted by name. The signed BPKI response is authenticated; resource certificate paths are not validated. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--classes))
- `id` (String) Stable SHA-256 identity of the protocol, endpoint, child/parent handles and BPKI anchors.

<a id="nestedatt--classes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `classes`

Read-Only:

- `asn` (String) Allocated ASN resource set in protocol syntax.
- `certificate_urls` (String) Comma-separated issuer certificate URLs reported by the parent.
- `certificates` (Attributes List) Issued certificates sorted by publication URLs and DER hash. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--classes--certificates))
- `ipv4` (String) Allocated IPv4 resource set in protocol syntax.
- `ipv6` (String) Allocated IPv6 resource set in protocol syntax.
- `issuer_pem` (String) Returned issuer certificate, PEM encoded. Not an independently authenticated RPKI trust anchor.
- `name` (String) Resource class name.
- `not_after` (String) Allocation expiry in UTC RFC 3339 format.
- `suggested_sia` (String) Optional suggested publication base, or null.

<a id="nestedatt--classes--certificates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `classes.certificates`

Read-Only:

- `certificate_pem` (String) Returned resource certificate, PEM encoded. Its resource trust path is not verified by this inventory read.
- `certificate_urls` (String) Comma-separated publication URLs reported by the parent.
- `requested_asn` (String) Echoed ASN request. Null means absent; an empty string requests no ASNs.
- `requested_ipv4` (String) Echoed IPv4 request. Null means absent; an empty string requests no IPv4 resources.
- `requested_ipv6` (String) Echoed IPv6 request. Null means absent; an empty string requests no IPv6 resources.
- `sha256` (String) SHA-256 of the DER certificate.
